- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Arosa has a large beginner area with gentle slopes and magic carpets, and offers ski schools and private lessons for beginners.

- [USER] The user is considering going skiing in late January or early February.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best snow conditions in Switzerland are typically found between December and April, with January and February often being the best months for powder.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Higher elevation resorts like Verbier or Zermatt can have snow well into May or June.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Weekends and school holidays tend to be busier and more expensive, so visiting during weekdays or offseason can lead to better rates and fewer crowds.
